description: This file defines the class HttpRequestFileUpload, which handles file uploads via an HttpServletRequest object. It includes functionality to parse multipart/form-data requests, handle file saving, and process form fields within a web server environment.

classes.name: HttpRequestFileUpload
classes.description: A utility class for handling file uploads received through an HttpServletRequest, supporting multipart parsing, file saving, and field extraction.

methods.name: doUpload
methods.description: Performs the upload process, reading from the HttpServletRequest, parsing multipart data, saving uploaded files, and extracting form fields.

methods.name: waitingReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line from ServletInputStream, waiting when necessary, used internally during multipart parsing.
